HERO.TITLE: Explore Our Modular Solutions
HERO.SUBTITLE: High-quality prefab structures for every need.

MODULAR.TITLE: Modular Workspaces
MODULAR.SHORT: Flexible modular office units for on-site or remote deployment.
MODULAR.FULL: Our modular workspaces are designed for maximum efficiency and fast deployment. Perfect for administrative, technical, or operations staff, each unit is insulated and customizable for internal layouts and connectivity.
MODULAR.SPEC_1_VALUE: 50mm Ready House panel with decorative plywood
MODULAR.SPEC_2_VALUE: 18mm plywood with vinyl tiles or carpet

RESIDENCES.TITLE: Portable Residences
RESIDENCES.SHORT: Custom-built living units with home comfort and insulation.
RESIDENCES.FULL: Designed for luxury and convenience, our residences offer durable solutions using premium materials. Suitable for villas, accommodations, or mobile lodging.
RESIDENCES.FEATURE_3: Equipped with full bathroom & kitchen systems
RESIDENCES.SPEC_1_VALUE: Decorative plywood and waterproof wall panels

STORAGE.TITLE: Secure Storage Units
STORAGE.SHORT: Durable, customizable storage containers with advanced protection.
STORAGE.FULL: Our storage modules are fabricated with precision and durability. Whether for equipment, materials, or personal storage, these units are insulated and available in various sizes.
STORAGE.SPEC_1_VALUE: 50mm panel system with corrugated steel sheeting

EVENT.TITLE: Event & Exhibition Modules
EVENT.SHORT: Fully equipped prefab setups for events, expos and festivals.
EVENT.FULL: We provide modular units for temporary or permanent event infrastructure. These units are optimized for lighting, display areas, and customer flow.
EVENT.SPEC_1_VALUE: 6mm plywood or tile ceiling, fiberglass insulation

SANITATION.TITLE: Sanitation Facilities
SANITATION.SHORT: Mobile and modular restrooms and toilets with hygienic features.
SANITATION.FULL: Our ready-to-use washroom modules ensure hygiene and comfort. Suitable for labor camps, construction sites, and public events.
SANITATION.SPEC_2_VALUE: Toilet, basin, mirror, TP holder, soap tray

PRAYER.TITLE: Prayer Sanctuaries
PRAYER.SHORT: Portable spiritual spaces built for comfort and reverence.
PRAYER.FULL: Designed with attention to Qibla orientation and serene ambience, these sanctuaries are perfect for both indoor and outdoor placement.

SHELTER.TITLE: Protective Shelters
SHELTER.SHORT: Heavy-duty shelters for safety during emergencies and crises.
SHELTER.FULL: Built to withstand harsh conditions, our protective units are essential for worker safety, site security, or emergency response systems.
SHELTER.SPEC_3_VALUE: Single or dual leaf aluminum doors

MULTI.TITLE: Multi-Level Cabins
MULTI.SHORT: Stackable prefab cabins with advanced design and functionality.
MULTI.FULL: We manufacture cabins that can be installed in multiple levels using steel structures. These are ideal for site offices, staff accommodations, or compact spaces.
MULTI.SPEC_1_VALUE: 2 to 3 levels supported with steel frame

MEDICAL.TITLE: Medical Units
MEDICAL.SHORT: Prefab clinics, isolation rooms and field healthcare spaces.
MEDICAL.FULL: Equipped with essential plumbing, electrical, and ventilation systems, our prefab medical units meet the needs of rapid health infrastructure deployment.
